pet_notes: Use the supplied avatar as the sole identity source: warm clay/3D-toy young Korean man, thick tousled black wavy hair with a center part and loose curls, brown eyes, natural gentle smile, warm beige skin. Preserve the same slim youthful full-body proportions in every frame: head approximately one quarter of total height, narrow shoulders, long straight legs, hands and shoes proportionate. Clothing identity is non-negotiable: one raglan long-sleeve shirt with a continuous light-gray heather torso panel and black collar, shoulders and sleeves; no hoodie, zipper, jacket, layered shirt, logo, text, or new accessories. Pants are always the same dark indigo-black straight-leg denim jeans with visible subtle copper stitching, natural cuffs at both ankles, no alternate colors, no joggers, no slacks, no shorts. Shoes are always the same charcoal black canvas low-top sneakers with off-white rubber toe caps and white laces. Keep facial identity, body scale, cloth colors, design seams, material and silhouette identical across every standard action and all 16 look directions. Use only a perfectly flat #ff00ff chroma background, with no shadows, effects, floor, or fringes.
